key_checks: Named atom toForm uses capture-correct rename and under-env identity; no injectivity/freshness premise is omitted.
Every sep_of/repl_of call supplies an actual NForm plus its semantic equivalence; every Replacement relation is globally partial-functional, including outside the chosen domain.
Ordinal and epsilon induction cut a definable counterexample set in a transitive successor/container; they do not invoke external well-foundedness.
Hierarchy gluing replaces each ordinal by its unique successor-domain approximation, and overlap agreement makes union a function. No arbitrary chosen family is collected.
Least-rank Replacement bounds all witness ranks without choosing an individual output. The final output set is separated from one V_beta.
The 100+k matrix parameters are protected along the actual atom ancestor binders; local helper binders may exceed 100 in separate branches that contain no atom, which is harmless.
Power containers include every raw-domain subset of every member, including subset objects outside the initial container.
No quotient IR, Foundation from CP/GIC, Choice axiom in the model, or standard-ZFC consistency equivalence follows from these four modules alone.
